summary.value: This is not a serious research contribution. Reviewers raised a number of objections which were not adequately addressed. None of the observations in this paper are new: the closed form for the empirical score function is well-known, and it does not contradict the fact that diffusion models can learn the distribution. The "unified framework" adds no new algorithmic innovation, nor are there any empirical results. The claims are strong yet indefensible. The writing is poor and does not adopt a proper scientific tone.
